items.title: A normal ring is integrally closed in its total ring of fractions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a normal ring is integrally closed in its total ring of fractions (statement lines 8434-8437). The proof does not use a determinant trick or the theory of integral closures of ideals: it introduces the ideal I of elements f with fx in R, localises at a prime, uses flatness of the localisation together with normality of the local ring to find a denominator outside that prime, and then concludes that I lies in no prime and hence equals R (proof lines 8439-8452). Passing from a prime-wise denominator to a global statement about the ideal I is the content, and the author writes the localisation step explicitly. H2.
